message.content:
Fixed thick film chip resistors fall in HTSUS heading 8533, "Electrical resistors (including rheostats and potentiometers), other than heating resistors." Subheading 8533.21 covers fixed resistors for a power handling capacity not exceeding 20 W. Within that subheading, 8533.21.00 is divided into statistical suffixes, and I recall 8533.21.0040 as "Fixed resistors, other than composition/film types" and 8533.21.0030 and 0050 as other categories. I am not certain of the exact suffix breakdown, so this is from memory.

My recollection of the 8533.21.00 statistical suffixes is:
- 8533.21.0010: Chip resistors (possibly)
- 8533.21.0030: Metal film
- 8533.21.0040: Carbon film
- 8533.21.0050: Other

Chip resistors are a separate category, so I am going with 8533.21.0010 as my best recollection, though the suffix is unconfirmed.
